conbody.p: If there is a problem with the Parking Distance Warning or related functions and parts, the instrument cluster displays a warning message.

You can check the contents of the warning in the service message of the utility information view of the instrument cluster. If the function still does not work properly, have the vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
